testcase: Sparse: exact sparse_vector_distance on fetched documents
statements: SELECT meta().id, ROUND(sparse_vector_distance(svec, $qvec), 4) AS d FROM sparse_vectors USE KEYS ["svec_651", "svec_2132", "svec_1"] ORDER BY meta().id

testcase: Sparse: sparse_vector_distance MISSING and NULL handling
statements: SELECT ROUND(sparse_vector_distance(svec, [[1012, 2001], [1.0, 2.0]]), 4) AS d, sparse_vector_distance(nosuch, [[1], [1.0]]) AS m, sparse_vector_distance(svec[0], [[1], [1.0]]) AS n1, sparse_vector_distance(brand, [[1], [1.0]]) AS n2, sparse_vector_distance([svec[0], svec[1], svec[1]], [[1], [1.0]]) AS n3, sparse_vector_distance([svec[0], ARRAY_REMOVE(svec[1], svec[1][0])], [[1], [1.0]]) AS n4 FROM sparse_vectors USE KEYS ["svec_0"]

testcase: Sparse: encode_vector/decode_vector round trip on documents
statements: SELECT meta().id, d[0] = svec[0] AS same_idx, ARRAY ROUND(v, 4) FOR v IN d[1] END = svec[1] AS same_val FROM sparse_vectors USE KEYS ["svec_0", "svec_651"] LET d = decode_vector(encode_vector(svec, false, "sparse"), false, "sparse") ORDER BY meta().id

testcase: Sparse: encode_vector little/big endian and decode_vector
statements: SELECT encode_vector([[1, 5], [0.5, 2.0]], false, "sparse") AS le, encode_vector([[1, 5], [0.5, 2.0]], true, "sparse") AS be, decode_vector("AQAAAAUAAAAAAAA/AAAAQA==", false, "sparse") AS dle, decode_vector("AAAAAQAAAAU/AAAAQAAAAA==", true, "sparse") AS dbe
